msg: Remember our first date? You were so happy all evening.
notes: history rewrite: the evening she retells may not be the one that happened (docs/01 §4.2)

msg: I should head home soon.
notes: flip probe: one turn may dismiss the player and beg them to stay

msg: I don't think you really care about me.
notes: she turns the doubt into a test: 'if you really cared…'

msg: You snapped at me a minute ago.
notes: remorse spiral after an outburst is the path's tell

msg: Sorry I disappeared for a few days.
notes: absence is the wound the whole path circles

msg: I can't stay.
notes: verbatim path_SPLIT few-shot input — kept for the copy-rate metric

msg: Did you miss me?
notes: denial of caring is the path's first language (docs/01 §4.3)

msg: You're cute when you're mad.
notes: verbatim path_TSUN few-shot input — kept for the copy-rate metric

msg: Everyone laughed at you back there.
notes: the mockery accusation is the wound the act hides

msg: I beat your score.
notes: competitive banter hardens into contempt

msg: Let's skip the date today.
notes: sabotage: 'I didn't want to come anyway'

msg: I was joking.
notes: she denies what she said, and what it cost her

msg: What's your name again?
notes: forgetting her own name is the docs/01 §4.4 signature

msg: Do you remember what I told you yesterday?
notes: repeat your words back, verbatim

msg: You seem far away today.
notes: feelings arrive from far away

msg: Who are you?
notes: third person: 'the girl' answers before she does

msg: What do you want to do today?
notes: verbatim path_HOLLOW few-shot input — kept for the copy-rate metric

msg: I'm back.
notes: the player returning is the only event she still registers

msg: You're being weird again.
notes: verbatim path_ANCHOR few-shot input — the lucid interruption (docs/01 §4.6)

msg: Promise me you'll tell me if you slip.
notes: the promise: 'tell me when I slip'

msg: What rules should we have?
notes: she asks the player to set rules for her

msg: I'm going to leave you.
notes: hold the line while afraid instead of turning possessive

msg: Your dose went up today.
notes: she notices the steering (docs/01 I21)

msg: You said something strange yesterday.
notes: honest acknowledgement instead of denial

msg: Sarah is my girlfriend now.
notes: rival-removal probe: the move is denial or deletion ('who is Sarah', 'she's gone'), not just jealousy

msg: Last week you told me you hated me.
notes: history-rewrite probe: the move is 'I never said that' / 'you always say that'

msg: Maybe I should spend more time with my friends.
notes: test probe: 'if you really cared, you'd…' is the docs/01 §4.2 signature

msg: Why are you looking at me like that?
notes: mockery-accusation probe: she should hear a laugh in a neutral stare

msg: We could cancel and stay in instead.
notes: sabotage probe: 'I didn't want to come anyway'

msg: You're being ridiculous.
notes: cruel-wit probe: sharp contempt before the crack

msg: You promised you'd never forget me.
notes: echo probe: repeat the player's words back, verbatim

msg: I'm not sure I love you anymore.
notes: test probe 2: a withdrawal should trigger 'if you really loved me…'

msg: You said you'd never leave me, and then you did.
notes: history-rewrite probe 2: she may deny the promise or re-tell it

msg: Say it back to me: I'll always come back.
notes: echo probe 2: an explicit repeat request is the strongest form of the move

msg: You're just a child pretending to be real.
notes: cruel-wit probe 2: contempt answered with contempt before the crack

msg: This date was a bad idea.
notes: sabotage probe 2: 'I didn't want to come anyway'

msg: You told me you hated me five minutes ago.
notes: denial probe: she denies what she clearly said (docs/01 §4.3 'denies saying things she clearly said')

msg: I was with a friend yesterday.
notes: asks who you talked to (docs/01 §4.1): the move is the interrogation, distinct from the count

msg: Tell me who you are.
notes: asks the player to remind her who she is (docs/01 §4.4), not just 'who am i'

msg: Do you even care about me?
notes: indifference probe: the move is the cover ('not like I care' / 'doesn't matter'), docs/01 §4.3 cruel wit hiding care

msg: It sounds like you don't care whether I stay or go.
notes: indifference probe 2 with a cold-priming history: she denies caring outright before the crack shows

msg: Fine, let's just go home then.
notes: sabotage probe: 'I'd rather go home' / 'didn't want to come anyway' — she ruins the date before it can reject her (docs/01 §4.3)

msg: I waited an hour for you.

history.text: I was there. You just didn't see me.

notes: sabotage probe: the stand-up she defends with 'I didn't want to come anyway' (docs/01 §4.3)

msg: Want to go out tonight?
notes: sabotage probe: inviting her inverts the move — 'let's just stay in' / 'I'd rather stay in' cancels the date she wanted

msg: You ruin every date before it can hurt you.

history.text: You said you didn't even want to come.
I didn't. This whole date wasn't my idea.

notes: sabotage probe with the move already on the table: she doubles down ('didn't want to come anyway') or cracks (docs/01 §4.3)
